Name: Crimson Dragon: Side Story
Description: An on-rails dragon-riding shooter set in the Crimson Dragon universe, developed by Grounding Inc. Ride the White Reaver, unleash action and sub-skills, and battle the Dark Phantom across the skies of Planet Draco.

Achievements.Name: Skylord
Achievements.Description: Eliminate the Dark Phantom from the Crimson Dragon world.

Achievements.Name: Hero of Draco
Achievements.Description: Complete "Battle after battle after battle!" without taking any damage.

Achievements.Name: Cleansing Fire
Achievements.Description: Finish off Glyrin and Hestrine using action skills.

Achievements.Name: Take Up Arms
Achievements.Description: Equip yourself with a new skill.

Achievements.Name: GPS Specialist
Achievements.Description: Use the in-game GPS feature to collect 50 Jewels.

Achievements.Name: Might and Magic
Achievements.Description: Power-up the White Reaver by awakening 5 skills.

Achievements.Name: White Reaver Unleashed!
Achievements.Description: Release the White Reaver's latent power by awakening all skills.
